messages:
liam: hi all, first-week question. running the backend in a container with docker-compose and trying to connect to Postgres. my env has DATABASE_HOST=localhost and app logs show connection refused. compose maps db:5432->localhost:5432 so I thought it would work.

emma: welcome! small gotcha: when your app runs inside a container, `localhost` refers to the app container itself, not your host machine. you need to connect to the db service hostname on the compose network (usually `db` if that's the service name).

liam: ahhh makes sense. so I should set DATABASE_HOST=db ? I tried that and then got a new error: "could not translate host name "db" to address" from the app container.

morgan: probably your app container is not on the same compose network as the db. are you using `docker compose up` for both services in the same compose file?

liam: yes docker compose up --build in the repo root. my compose file has services: web, db. web depends_on db.

emma: can you `docker compose exec web ping db` and `docker compose exec web nslookup db`? that usually shows whether the internal DNS is working.

liam: ran `docker compose exec web ping db` and it says `ping: unknown host db`.

morgan: that indicates the web container may be started outside compose or using a different project name. double-check `docker compose ps` output and look at the NETWORKS column. Also make sure there isn't a top-level `network_mode: host` in one of the services which disables compose network.

liam: `docker compose ps` shows web and db but web has NETWORKS empty and db has default. I had accidentally set `network_mode: host` in the web service earlier while testing. removed it, restarted and now `docker compose exec web ping db` works.

liam: after changing DATABASE_HOST=db the app connects and migrations run. thanks! should we add a note to onboarding about the localhost vs service-host gotcha?

infra-bot: added a short note to dev-setup: "Inside container use service hostnames (db, redis) not localhost; avoid network_mode: host for compose dev stacks" https://go.redwood/dev-setup (:book:)

liam: perfect. pinging @emma to add a one-liner to the quickstart README. :tada:
